texts.en:
By projecting our will into the Shroud, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess expert control over their psionic trances.

Where others may have let the Shroud itself forge their destiny, we have maintained true independence of will.

The psionic potential of the [this.GetName] has been fulfilled.

# 灵能精通 / Psionic Mastery

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:8305-8335`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5743-5747 (on_active_accord_unlocked)`; `common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt:572-585 (SHROUD_SHAPING_PROJECT)`; `events/shroud_events.txt:8162-8180 (3500)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

解锁一项主动协约时（on_active_accord_unlocked）检查：正在“自寻出路”（forging_our_own_path，来自契约提案中的“自寻出路”与塑造虚境项目）且已解锁4项主动协约。

Checked when an active accord is unlocked (on_active_accord_unlocked): the empire is forging its own path (forging_our_own_path, from the covenant offers' "forge our own path" and the Shaping the Shroud project) and has four active accords unlocked.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

不受任何赞助者束缚而汲取多个领域的力量，灵能者掌握了出神之术。

Having drawn power from several patrons' domains without being bound, our telepaths master their trances.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项：五级泽珞奖励与“灵能精通”修正。

Only option: a tier-5 zro reward and the Psionic Mastery modifier.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

这是“自寻出路”路线（见五个契约故事中的塑造虚境项目与 3500/3510）的终点奖励，由协约解锁状态触发，保持为独立卡片并在导读中说明关系。

This is the end reward of the "forge our own path" route (see the Shaping the Shroud project and 3500/3510 in the five covenant stories), fired by accord unlock state; kept as its own card with the relation explained here.
